hooks.name: Keep the Kiro log
hooks.description: Builds the 'how we used Kiro' writeup as we go.

action.prompt: Append to docs/KIRO_LOG.md (create if missing) a dated entry of at most 3 lines: what changed this turn, which Kiro feature drove it (spec task, hook, steering, MCP, skill), and anything worth showing in the demo.
